ky-b423d248-c5ae-49de-a4f7-3cbdccde5227.title: DLRT - Trailhead Caution
ky-b423d248-c5ae-49de-a4f7-3cbdccde5227.text: Please avoid the Breathitt County section and beware of rough spots between the Jane Beshear Trailhead to Tip Top.

ky-976ad384-e2d4-41ab-bd17-685c33b092e7.title: Improvements
ky-976ad384-e2d4-41ab-bd17-685c33b092e7.text: The Kentucky State Parks system is currently undergoing renovations at select park locations to enhance facilities and visitor experiences.

nps-92DFEDDC-9091-44BA-9C49-4240D319B8C4.title: Fort Donelson NB Park Fall Hours
nps-92DFEDDC-9091-44BA-9C49-4240D319B8C4.text: Visitor Access to Fort Donelson NB Park Lands: Pedestrian Access is from sunrise to sunset. Automobile Access to Fort Donelson NB Park Roads 8:00 am – 6:00 p.m. daily.

nps-B489F041-FD1B-40F2-992D-9D36C841B7E5.title: Green River Ferry Temporarily Out of Service
nps-B489F041-FD1B-40F2-992D-9D36C841B7E5.text: The Green River Ferry has temporarily suspended operation due to low water levels. Ferry service will resume once water levels rise and conditions are safe. A river forecast is available at: water.noaa.gov/gauges/03309000

nps-8E5C80A8-445B-4B70-8262-A7522F1C293E.title: Trail Maintenance Underway Near Sand Cave
nps-8E5C80A8-445B-4B70-8262-A7522F1C293E.text: Crews are using Ridge Trail from Hensley to Sand Cave Trail to complete trail work. Trails remain open; some sections may be muddy or messy.

nps-F322E0B6-54E5-4887-A604-7F59C4F08765.title: Elevator for Accessible Tour Out of Service
nps-F322E0B6-54E5-4887-A604-7F59C4F08765.text: Due to mechanical issues with the cave elevator, the Accessible Tour is currently unavailable. Please check back for updates or call the visitor center at (270) 758-2180.

nps-41955910-CBC1-4A0A-B3B6-6749C6D6FF39.title: The Use of Drones is Prohibited at Big South Fork National River & Recreation Area
nps-41955910-CBC1-4A0A-B3B6-6749C6D6FF39.text: Currently, the use of drones is prohibited at Big South Fork and all National Parks. Detailed information about the policy is available...

nps-442E4F2B-C87C-4984-8315-DA2B02F729F3.title: Big South Fork Announces Temporary Closure of Blue Heron Tipple Bridge
nps-442E4F2B-C87C-4984-8315-DA2B02F729F3.text: Big South Fork NRRA has announced the temporary closure of the historic Blue Heron Tipple Bridge, effective immediately in the interest of visitor safety. A recent bridge safety inspection conducted by the Federal Highway Administration identified structural issues specific to the pier’s bridge decking which is now leaning beyond acceptable standards.

nps-C2602670-C157-4F9E-9A64-5B177A2E4344.title: Temporary Closure of Select Trails for Rehabilitation Project
nps-C2602670-C157-4F9E-9A64-5B177A2E4344.text: The Old Guides Trail, Heritage Trail, Sunset Point Trail and areas of the Sinkhole Trail are currently closed due to a trail rehabilitation project.

nps-3FDA6968-C4B7-4A28-8169-B0E4B1272765.title: Tickets are required to enter Mammoth Cave
nps-3FDA6968-C4B7-4A28-8169-B0E4B1272765.text: Reservations are strongly recommended. Reservations are the only way to ensure a spot is available for your party. Please plan accordingly by visiting Recreation.gov to secure your tickets in advance. Availability of walk-up tickets is not guaranteed.

nps-6B262C5A-387C-4AAE-B3A4-31461DB05D04.title: Firewood ban is in effect for the park.
nps-6B262C5A-387C-4AAE-B3A4-31461DB05D04.text: Firewood ban is in effect for the park. Only firewood from the surrounding counties of Scott, Morgan, Pickett, and Fentress, in Tennessee, and McCreary in Kentucky, can be brought into the park. Firewood is for sale or you may use dead and down wood.

nps-2F92DCC9-55CD-440F-A35C-8B08AA1558B5.title: Black Bears at Big South Fork
nps-2F92DCC9-55CD-440F-A35C-8B08AA1558B5.text: Black bears call Big South Fork NRRA home. Help keep them healthy and safe by storing all food, cooking items, feed, cosmetics and coolers properly stored when at campgrounds or in the backcountry.

fs-national-visitor-use-monitoring-oct-2.title: National Visitor Use Monitoring, Oct 2026-Sept 2027
fs-national-visitor-use-monitoring-oct-2.text: From October 2026 through September 2027, survey interviewers will be conducting National Visitor Use Monitoring surveys of Daniel Boone National Forest visitors around the Forest. fs-low-water-levels-laurel-river-lake-0.text: Laurel River Lake levels recently dropped approx. 15 ft below normal summer pool. Water access walkways and boat ramps may be steeper than usual, and potential unusable, until water levels rise.Check current lake levels for Laurel River Lake before planning your visit. fs-scott-creek-boat-ramp-briefly-inacces.text: Scott Creek Boat Ramp on Cave Run Lake will be inaccessible Thursday, July 30 from 8-9 a.m. while a boat owner replaces the roof on their house boat.

fs-no-phone-service-pass-sales-redbird-o.text: The Redbird Ranger District Office in Big Creek, KY does not have phone or internet service at this time and is unable to process map or pass sales. fs-active-logging-operations-near-redbir.title: Active logging operations near Redbird Crest Trail Sections 17-19
fs-active-logging-operations-near-redbir.text: Logging operations have begun near Redbird Crest Trail Sections 17-19 as part of the Little Flat Creek Stewardship Project. Ride cautiously on the sections of trail that travel between Trace Branch Road (NFSR-1501C) and KY-2000 in the Mud Lick area of Clay County.

fs-cliffside-trail-519-closure.title: Cliffside Trail #519 Closure
fs-cliffside-trail-519-closure.text: Cliffside Trail #519 between Noes Boat Ramp and Sawyer Boat Ramp is temporarily closed due to downed trees and trail damage.

fs-dog-slaughter-falls-trail-closure-bri.title: Dog Slaughter Falls Trail Closure, Bridge Removed
fs-dog-slaughter-falls-trail-closure-bri.text: Extensive storm damage remains on a portion of the Dog Slaughter Falls Trail. Currently, the trail is closed between the two trailheads. The lower trailhead and parking area closest to the falls, remains open for use and is passable to the falls. Please note that the bridge at the lower trailhead…

fs-hawk-creek-sinking-creek-trail-bridge.text: The Hawk Creek and Sinking Creek suspension bridges, which connect portions of the Sheltowee Trace National Recreation Trail near London, KY, are impassable due to storm damage. Hikers will need to wade through the creeks to continue along the trail. As a safety precaution, please do not try to…

fs-red-river-gorge-suspension-bridge-imp.title: Red River Gorge Suspension Bridge Impassable
fs-red-river-gorge-suspension-bridge-imp.text: The suspension footbridge near KY 715 in the Red River Gorge that connects the Sheltowee Trace National Recreation Trail across the Red River has been damaged by a falling tree. Visitors should not attempt to use the bridge and should plan their recreation activities accordingly.Area(s): Sheltowee…

fs-climbing-and-rappelling-prohibitions-.title: Climbing and Rappelling Prohibitions
fs-climbing-and-rappelling-prohibitions-.text: Climbing or rappelling or otherwise attempting to ascend or descend from cliffs, arches, or other rock formations at Bee Rock Overlook in Laurel County in Kentucky is prohibited.

fs-climbing-and-rappelling-prohibitions-.title: Climbing and Rappelling Prohibitions
fs-climbing-and-rappelling-prohibitions-.text: Climbing or rappelling within 300 feet of Sky Bridge, Gray’s Arch, Nada Tunnel, or Chimney Top Rock overlooks is prohibited.

fs-non-motorized-fishing-area-restrictio.title: Non-Motorized Fishing Area Restrictions
fs-non-motorized-fishing-area-restrictio.text: The use of use of gasoline or diesel-powered motorcraft in non-motorized fishing areas of Cave Run Lake, Carrington Lake, Rebel Trace Lake, Clear Creek Lake, and specified portions of Ramey Creek and Scott Creek is prohibited.

fs-climbing-and-rappelling-prohibitions.title: Climbing and Rappelling Prohibitions
fs-climbing-and-rappelling-prohibitions.text: Climbing, rappelling, or otherwise attempting to ascend or descend from cliffs, arches, or other rock formations in the Natural Arch Scenic Area and Three Forks of Beaver Overlook is prohibited.

fs-wildcat-branch-closure.title: Wildcat Branch Closure
fs-wildcat-branch-closure.text: Going into or upon National Forest System lands of Wildcat Branch, within the Bee Rock Overlook in Laurel County in Kentucky, is prohibited.

fs-trail-prohibitions.title: Trail Prohibitions
fs-trail-prohibitions.text: Shortcutting a trail switchback is prohibited.

fs-prohibited-entry-special-areas.title: Prohibited Entry into Special Areas
fs-prohibited-entry-special-areas.text: Entry into areas closed for the protection of endangered, threatened, rare, unique, or vanishing species of plants, animals, birds, or fish around Cave Run Lake and Laurel River Lake is prohibited.

fs-metal-detecting-prohibitions-0.title: Metal Detecting Prohibitions
fs-metal-detecting-prohibitions-0.text: The use of metal detectors, electronic apparatuses, or any other devices for the purpose of locating any metal object without a valid permit is prohibited.

fs-commercial-hauling-prohibitions.title: Commercial Hauling Prohibitions
fs-commercial-hauling-prohibitions.text: Using a Forest Service System Road for commercial hauling without first obtaining a permit or authorization is prohibited.

fs-cave-run-lake-trails-restrictions.title: Cave Run Lake Trails Restrictions
fs-cave-run-lake-trails-restrictions.text: 1) All cross country travel by horses, pack animals, or other livestock within the described area in the Cave Run Lake Trail Guide; 2) leading, using or possessing a saddle or pack animal within the twelve horse trail segments from December 15 to May 15; and 3) non-designated use of the twenty-one…

fs-cave-run-lake-highway-801-huntingshoo.title: Cave Run Lake, Highway 801 Hunting/Shooting Prohibitions
fs-cave-run-lake-highway-801-huntingshoo.text: Hunting or discharging a firearm is prohibited between Kentucky Highway 801 South and Cave Run Lake from the Fern Bluff recreation area to Warix Run Boat Ramp, including the waters of Scott Creek Bay east of the idle speed buoy line between Scott Creek Boat Ramp and Twin Knobs Boat Ramp.

fs-shallow-flats-wildlife-viewing-area-c.title: Shallow Flats Wildlife Viewing Area Closure
fs-shallow-flats-wildlife-viewing-area-c.text: 1) All entry; 2) discharging a firearm; and 3) hunting, fishing and trapping are prohibited in the described area.

fs-pioneer-weapons-wildlife-management-a.title: Pioneer Weapons Wildlife Management Area Camping Prohibition
fs-pioneer-weapons-wildlife-management-a.text: Except for designated sites, camping within 300 feet of National Forest System Road 918 in the Pioneer Weapons Wildlife Management Area is prohibited.

fs-white-sulphur-ohv-trail-system.text: 1) Motorized use of the White Sulphur OHV Trail System from sunset to sunrise from May 1st to November 30th; 2) Non-motorized use of the White Sulphur OHV Trail System from May 1st to November 30th; 3) Overnight camping within 300 feet of the edge of the White Sulphur OHV Trail System from May 1st…

fs-beaver-creek-wilderness-prohibitions.title: Beaver Creek Wilderness Prohibitions
fs-beaver-creek-wilderness-prohibitions.text: Within Beaver Creek Wilderness, possessing horses or other livestock except on trails designated for such use or as specifically permitted through a special use permit is prohibited.

fs-jellico-rock-creek-camping-prohibitio.title: Jellico & Rock Creek Camping Prohibitions
fs-jellico-rock-creek-camping-prohibitio.text: Except for designated campsites, camping within 300 feet of National Forest System Road 492 and National Forest System Road 137 is prohibited.

fs-bee-rock-camping-prohibitions.title: Bee Rock Camping Prohibitions
fs-bee-rock-camping-prohibitions.text: Camping or maintaining any campsite or campsites within Bee Rock Recreation Area for more than 14 consecutive days is prohibited.

fs-laurel-river-lake-and-lake-cumberland.title: Laurel River Lake and Lake Cumberland Camping Prohibitions
fs-laurel-river-lake-and-lake-cumberland.text: 1) Camping within 300 feet of the high water line of the portion of Upper Lake Cumberland, from the Mouth of Laurel Boat Ramp upstream on the Laurel River, and from the Sheltowee Trace National Recreation Trail to the administrative boundary between National Forest System and U.S. Army Corps of…

fs-cave-run-lake-camping-restrictions.title: Cave Run Lake Camping Restrictions
fs-cave-run-lake-camping-restrictions.text: Except at designated sites, camping within 300 feet of the water’s edge of Cave Run Lake or within 300 feet of any road or trail leading to the water’s edge of Cave Run Lake is prohibited.

fs-general-forest-prohibitions.title: General Forest Prohibitions
fs-general-forest-prohibitions.text: The following acts are prohibited in all areas of the Daniel Boone National Forest:Building, maintaining, attending or using a fire, campfire or stove within 100 feet of the base of any cliff, or the back of a rock shelter unless at a designated site;Possession of a controlled substance unless said…

fs-shooting-range-prohibitions.title: Shooting Range Prohibitions
fs-shooting-range-prohibitions.text: The following acts are prohibited within shooting ranges:Use of all targets including clay, skeet, paintball, or exploding targets except for targets that are made of paper or a retail product specifically designed for target practice;Failure to adhere to posted range safety rules;Firing while…

fs-wilderness-prohibitions.title: Wilderness Prohibitions
fs-wilderness-prohibitions.text: Entering or being part of a group of more than ten people and/or possessing or using a wagon, cart, bicycle or other vehicle are prohibited in Clifty Wilderness and Beaver Creek Wilderness.

fs-camping-prohibitions.title: Camping Prohibitions
fs-camping-prohibitions.text: Camping in violation of posted signs is prohibited.

fs-saddle-and-pack-animal-prohibitions.title: Saddle and Pack Animal Prohibitions
fs-saddle-and-pack-animal-prohibitions.text: Riding, hitching, tethering, or hobbling a horse or other saddle or pack animal in violation of posted instructions is prohibited.

fs-tater-knob-fire-tower-closure.title: Tater Knob Fire Tower Closure
fs-tater-knob-fire-tower-closure.text: Going into or upon the Tater Knob Fire Tower site is prohibited.

fs-red-river-gorge-camping-restrictions.title: Red River Gorge Camping Restrictions
fs-red-river-gorge-camping-restrictions.text: Except at designated sites, camping within 300 feet of any developed road or trail in the Red River Gorge Geological Area or within 600 feet of Gray’s Arch is prohibited.
